asap_stages.label: Align
asap_stages.summary: Know the whole course before choosing the next step.
asap_stages.scope: Reconcile the current population census, blueprint, curriculum coverage, teaching design, tree and pricing.
asap_stages.proof: Every applicable population has a current inventory and a course-owned requirement. Earlier courses grant a new course no completion credit.

asap_stages.label: Synthesize
asap_stages.summary: Create and accept every required content population.
asap_stages.scope: Author and repair content, verify items and complete forms, and satisfy native bank and QTI checks.
asap_stages.proof: Acceptance is measured separately for each population. A gate-bank PASS does not prove practice, writing, media or whole-course readiness.
tools: Current native generation and item QC

asap_stages.label: Assemble
asap_stages.summary: Connect accepted content to the learner experience.
asap_stages.scope: Compile native assets and use the course-owned publication route with exact readback, media, structure and XP evidence.
asap_stages.proof: Integrated, published and served coverage require their own receipts. Partial publication does not establish complete assembly.
tools: Native publisher and exact served readback

asap_stages.label: Prove
asap_stages.summary: Verify the final course and retain required human decisions.
asap_stages.scope: Final cold course QC, native learner acceptance, the human walkthrough and the recorded release decision.
asap_stages.proof: Use the native cold-QC bar and checker evidence, learner and XP readbacks, and the required human acceptance. A phase label cannot grant release authority.
tools: Native course QC and learner acceptance
